solo.description: One PC owns orchestration, storage, memory, approvals, and backups.

vps.description: Optional remote gateway or automation node; it never owns the home disk.

second-pc.description: Optional compute or thin-client node; the solo PC remains storage authority.

direct_network_mount.warning: Do not place SQLite, Chroma, or another multi-writer store on a shared mount.
direct_network_mount.allowed_use: read-only project files or backup transfer
